# RealityCheck

RealityCheck is a local-first, evidence-first Web quality audit skill and CLI. Before browser access, it can write a bilingual audit-plan preview of effective coverage, safety, and data retention. It then uses a real installed Chrome, Edge, or Chromium browser to stress responsive layouts, user journeys, API and network recovery, links, publishing metadata, visual baselines, performance, accessibility, security policy, and aggregate Cookie/Web Storage privacy budgets. It writes bilingual human reports plus machine-readable JSON, SARIF, JUnit, repair plans, policy reviews, issue drafts, manifests, verification evidence, and freshness-aware GO/REVIEW/NO-GO release decisions.

RealityCheck never treats an unsupported check as passed. Audit mode is read-only, remote targets require explicit authorization, and generated GitHub issue drafts are local files that are never submitted automatically.

## Quick start

Clone the repository, run `npm install`, then run `npm run demo`. To preview an existing project policy without browser access, run `npx realitycheck plan --config realitycheck.config.json`. To audit an authorized local app, run `npm run audit -- http://localhost:3000`.
